name: How do I choose the right contractor to repair a foreclosed home interior?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor to repair a foreclosed home interior?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a contractor for foreclosed property repairs, look for an owner-operated professional who handles hands-on finish carpentry, drywall, and painting while managing trade partners for mechanicals. Verify that the company holds active licensing, carries adequate general liability insurance, and maintains a strong track record, such as BBB accreditation with an A+ rating. It is also important to choose someone who acts as a direct on-site lead rather than delegating your project to distant sales reps, ensuring direct communication regarding daily progress, drywall patch quality, and trim detailing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an insured, hands-on contractor with proven finish carpentry, drywall, and trade-coordination capabilities and verifiable client ratings.
